tei:titleStmt.tei:title: תְּחִנָה זאָגט מען װען מען בּײַסט אָפּ דעם פִּטוּם פוּן דעם אֶתְרוֹג
Tkhine for when biting the pitom from the etrog (Siddur Ḳorban Minḥah, 1861)

tei:div.tei:head: Tkhine for when biting the pitom from the etrog (Siddur Ḳorban Minḥah, 1861)

tei:l.tei:note: This teḥinah is recited when biting off the pitum:

tei:lg.tei:l: Master of the Universe, the Lord of the world —
Because Ḥavah ate from the apple, all us women suffer from the punishment of death. If I were there, I would certainly not have wanted to derive any pleasure from the apple.
[I am] so virtuous that I did not derive any pleasure from the etrog for seven entire days, because it was designated to be used [exclusively] for a mitsvah.

Even though today, on Hoshana Rabbah, the mitsvah is over, nevertheless I still do not have any desire to derive any pleasure from it. And just like I have so little pleasure from this pitum, so too I would have had little pleasure from the apple that You forbade to derive pleasure from.
